values.note: Fewer than 40 sites: back-ins and standard pull-throughs take rigs to 40 ft, premium pull-throughs to 55 ft. The site is assigned on arrival.

facilities.source: https://lamesarvpark.com/amenities-2/ ('Coin-operated laundry facilities'; 'High speed WiFi throughout the park'; '(Please note: No showers, restrooms or cable tv available)') + https://parkwith.us/camps/la-mesa-rv-park ('No public showers or restrooms are available'). values.note: Water is limited over winter, November 1 to April 1.

season.source: https://lamesarvpark.com/rates/ ('La Mesa RV Park is proud to be able to offer year-round accommodations') + https://parkwith.us/camps/la-mesa-rv-park ('water availability is limited over-winter from November 1st to April 1st'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Online through Park With Us, or call or text 505-215-0712 (November-February reservations by phone or text only). No refunds; credits good for a year, none on holidays. Check-in noon, check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://parkwith.us/camps/la-mesa-rv-park ('Text or call 505-215-0712 for November through February reservations'; refund policy) + https://lamesarvpark.com/rates/ (CHECK-IN 12:00 pm / CHECK-OUT 11:00 am; REFUNDS), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Back-in full hookup $50 a night (tax included by phone), the same on an October and a June Friday; pull-through $55 on the rate sheet, $60 standard / $65 premium online. Online checkout adds 'Fees' of 12.5% ($6.25 on a back-in). Two people included, $5 per extra guest. Weekly $260-$330 with $50 of electricity; monthly on request.

discounts.source: https://lamesarvpark.com/rates/ ('Discounts at 10% - We honor Good Sam, Military, Veterans, Escapees, Coast to Coast, AAA'; 'La Mesa RV Park is a Passport Campground! ... limited to 1 discounted night only ... Cash only'), read 2026-10-27

note: Small in-town RV park on E. Main St in Cortez, less than 10 miles from Mesa Verde NP. EV/Tesla charging on request; horse-trailer RVs welcome. Harvest Hosts member. --Claude
summary: Park site (home, rates, amenities) + Park With Us checkout quotes: confirmed 50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, laundry, WiFi, year-round, $50 back-in (13 km from Mesa Verde, so the gateway exception covers it anyway), Good Sam/military 10%. Changed showers true -> false (park: 'No showers, restrooms'), dump true -> unknown (none listed), fees high 55 -> 50 (base back-in; pull-throughs in the note); added max rig 55, toilets false, Passport America, booking channel and the winter-water note. Note: dropped the field restatements and the wrong 'hot showers'/'dump station'.
flags: Phone 505-215-0712 (New Mexico area code) is the park's own published number - site header, booking page 'call or text 505-215-0712'. Keep.

Price gate: back-in $50 with tax by phone, $56.25 online once Park With Us adds its 12.5% 'Fees'; pull-throughs $55 by phone, $60-65 + fees online. Mesa Verde NP gateway at 13 km covers it either way.
No restrooms or showers at all - self-contained rigs only in practice.
Open now; booking site sells October-November 2026 and June 2027.
